title: About
subtitle: What Viewscape One is, how to drive it, and how it treats your device.
description: A folder-driven holographic data field. Every tile is a page; every page gets the radial wheel.
author: sys

blocks.title: A field of **windows**.
blocks.subtitle: Static, build-free, GitHub-Pages-ready. Each tile is a folder with its own HTML, CSS and JS — or just a `page.json` — shown inside a holographic box.

paragraphs: The **home field** lists every page from the source folders (`me`, `ai`, `sys`). Tap a tile and the page loads inside a hologram frame; the statusbar on top shows where you are, and everything you can *do* lives in the **radial wheel** on the right.

Pages are plain folders under `pages/<source>/<slug>/`. A page can be hand-written, generated by an AI, or driven by JSON blocks. Nothing needs compiling, so you can edit a file, push, and it is live.

blocks.title: The wheel is the navigation
blocks.text: There is no menu bar. **Touch:** swipe in from the right edge, or tap the orb. **Mouse:** hold the orb, drag toward a wedge, release. **Keyboard:** `W`, arrows, `Enter`, `1`–`8`.

rows: Swipe in from the right edge
Opens the wheel under your thumb
Pick a wedge in one motion
Opens a sub-wheel; tap the centre to go back
Move the orb up, mid or low for thumb reach

blocks.text: The orb **dims itself** while you read and wakes when you scroll up or touch the screen, so it never sits on your content.

items: Press **F**, tap the expand icon in the statusbar, or use **Window ▸ Fullscreen**.
Chrome / Edge: use the **install** button in the statusbar (or the address-bar icon) — the app then launches in true fullscreen with no browser chrome.
Safari does not allow fullscreen for websites on iPhone.
Tap **Share ▸ Add to Home Screen**. Launched from the icon, Viewscape runs fullscreen with a translucent status area and safe-area padding.

blocks.text: Once installed, the service worker keeps the framework available **offline** (network first, so new pushes still show up immediately).

items.title: Split view
items.text: From any page: wheel ▸ Window ▸ Split view, then pick a second page. Two pages side by side (stacked on portrait phones).

items.title: Pop out
items.text: Open the current page in its own window — drag it onto a second monitor.

items.title: Other screen
items.text: On browsers with the Window Management API, home ▸ Window ▸ Other screen opens a full-size window on your secondary display.

items.title: Cast
items.text: With two Viewscape windows open, **Cast** sends the current page to the other one. The statusbar shows how many windows are linked.

blocks.text: Display preferences and the accent colour sync between windows automatically.

paragraphs: Viewscape is heavy on glow, so it is built to back off. **Lite mode** switches on automatically on low-core or low-memory devices, in data-saver, and when the battery is under 20% and not charging. It removes backdrop blur, the grid floor, scanlines and particle links.
Animation also **pauses** when the tab is hidden, after 45 seconds without input, and for the home field while a page is open. Particles run at a capped frame rate on touch devices.
